title: Registry: acl revoke admin is refused (break-glass protection)
description: Runs `nexus acl registry revoke --user admin --yes`. The built-in Harbor admin is the break-glass operator identity; the adapter refuses to demote it (an actionable refusal, never a silent allow).

observe.what: an actionable refusal: the protected built-in admin is never demoted

whatProves: RegistryAdapter.AclAsync revoke/grant manage the Harbor sysadmin flag via PUT /api/v2.0/users/{id}/sysadmin; the built-in admin is protected (refused). Onboarded (OIDC) users are the grant/revoke targets — local-user creation is disabled in oidc_auth mode.
